# Subhasish Adhikary - Complete Profile

> Growth marketing and GTM strategist with 6+ years of experience building go-to-market systems for B2B SaaS, staffing, HR technology, MarTech, and digital businesses. This website provides comprehensive GTM intelligence tools, B2B marketing tool stacks, a 150+ term marketing glossary, and strategic marketing articles.

## About Subhasish Adhikary

**Professional Background:**
- Growth Marketing & GTM Strategist
- 6+ years of experience in B2B marketing
- Based in Hyderabad, India
- Specializes in building go-to-market systems that connect strategy, data, automation, and AI

**Core Specializations:**
- B2B go-to-market (GTM) strategy
- Growth marketing
- Marketing automation
- GTM engineering
- AI marketing and AI operations
- Demand generation
- Product marketing
- Revenue operations (RevOps)
- Cold email and outbound marketing
- Marketing analytics and attribution

**Industry Experience:**
- B2B SaaS
- Staffing and recruiting technology
- HR technology (HRMS/ATS)
- Marketing technology (MarTech)
- Digital businesses

**Professional Approach:**
Subhasish builds GTM systems that integrate strategy, data, automation, and AI to create scalable, measurable marketing operations. Focus on connecting marketing activities to business outcomes through systematic approaches rather than tactical execution.

## GTM Intelligence Tool

**URL:** https://subhasishadhikary.com/tools/gtm-intelligence

**What it does:**
Interactive GTM intelligence tool that helps B2B companies build comprehensive go-to-market strategies. The tool analyzes company inputs and generates a complete GTM strategy.

**Inputs:**
- Company stage (startup, growth, enterprise)
- Product/service description
- Target market and ICP
- Resources and budget
- Current marketing channels
- Business goals and objectives

**Outputs:**
- Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) definition
- Positioning and messaging framework
- Channel strategy and prioritization
- Marketing automation recommendations
- Implementation roadmap
- Success metrics and KPIs

**Use cases:**
- Early-stage startups building their first GTM strategy
- Growth-stage companies optimizing their GTM motion
- Enterprises restructuring their marketing operations
- Companies evaluating AI marketing implementation

## GTM Stack Visualization

**URL:** https://subhasishadhikary.com/gtm-stack

**What it is:**
Interactive visualization showing how different marketing technologies connect across the complete GTM motion. The stack visualization demonstrates how tools integrate across awareness, consideration, decision, and retention stages.

**What users can learn:**
- How marketing technologies integrate across the buyer journey
- Which tools work together in a cohesive stack
- How to build a complete marketing technology stack
- Best practices for marketing technology integration
- How to align marketing technology with GTM strategy

## B2B Marketing Tool Stacks Directory

**URL:** https://subhasishadhikary.com/gtm-stack

**What it contains:**
Comprehensive directory of 79+ B2B marketing technology stacks organized by category. Each stack includes tool recommendations, use cases, implementation guidance, and integration patterns.
